q: What is the process of taking food by an organism called?
e: Process of taking food by an organism called is Nutrition. Nutrition is the idea that completes this fact. Digestion is a different claim from Nutrition.

q: What are the two types of nutrition?
e: The two types of nutrition are autotrophic and Heterotrophic. Heterotrophs must take in food made by other organisms. Aerobic and Anaerobic is a different claim from Autotrophic and Heterotrophic.

q: Which of the following is a characteristic of autotrophic nutrition?
a: Organisms depend on others for food
Organisms can produce their own food
e: Organisms can produce their own food is a characteristic of autotrophic nutrition. Organisms can produce their own food is the idea that completes this fact. Organisms depend on others for food is not a characteristic of autotrophic nutrition.

q: What is the role of chlorophyll in plants?
e: Role of chlorophyll in plants is Capture sunlight. Capture sunlight is the idea that completes this fact. Absorb nutrients is a different claim from Capture sunlight.

q: What is the main function of the digestive system in humans?
e: Main function of the digestive system in humans is To absorb nutrients. To absorb nutrients is the idea that completes this fact. To produce hormones is a different claim from To absorb nutrients.

q: Which of the following is a type of heterotrophic nutrition?
e: Ingestion is a type of heterotrophic nutrition. Ingestion is the taking in of food. Chemosynthesis is not a type of heterotrophic nutrition.

q: What is the process by which plants convert light energy into chemical energy?
e: Process by which plants convert light energy into chemical energy is Photosynthesis. Photosynthesis uses chlorophyll to trap light and build sugar from carbon dioxide and water. Fermentation is a different claim from Photosynthesis.

q: Which of the following is NOT a function of the digestive system?
e: Blood circulation is the option that does not belong with the rest. Blood circulation is the idea that completes this fact. Chemical digestion is among the listed items, so it is not the exception.

Macronutrients are nutrients needed in large amounts. Nutrients needed in large amounts is the idea that completes this fact. Vitamins and minerals is a different claim from Nutrients needed in large amounts.

q: What is the primary source of energy for living organisms?
e: Primary source of energy for living organisms is Carbohydrates. Carbohydrates is the idea that completes this fact. Vitamins is a different claim from Carbohydrates.
